title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-08-17
lineage: AUD > MC > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Listenably rare audience tape of obscure Fillmore songs, but the recording’s provenance and show authenticity are heavily disputed.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a handful of seldom‑heard Fillmore tracks that sound decent for an AUD source, though reviewers note the audio is “rare and poor” yet still listenable. Much of the discussion centers on whether the date and venue are correct, with several users calling the set fabricated or mis‑dated, leading to mixed feelings about the performance itself.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is unclear and marred by authenticity disputes (≈2.8/5), while the audience recording is deemed fair‑to‑good (≈3.0/5). Combined weighted rating yields about 2.9 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the AUD tape as rare, a bit muddy and poor by modern standards but still listenable with some ambient room tone.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No clear commentary on set structure; reviewers focus on the rarity of the songs rather than performance flow.
